channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Scoot Henderson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Scoot Henderson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Toumani Camara on Scoot Henderson
item.description:
Toumani Camara on Scoot Henderson:

“To me, he put it together. Scoot always been super athletic, super fast, great finisher, great driver, great shooter, and I feel like now mentally he just put it all together. How can he affect the team defensively, how scrappy he could get, and offensively make the right play every time. I think there’s no one time this summer where I’m like, ‘You should have done this, Scoot.’ Every time he drive and making a decision, it’s the right one and it’s the one that we need for the team.”

Toumani Camara on Scoot Henderson, Oct 10, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Scoot Henderson
item.description:
Jrue Holiday on Scoot Henderson:

“I think when Scoot got comfortable, you saw what he's capable of and that's the tip of the iceberg. Him getting a full season of being healthy ... I think he has a bright future.”

Jrue Holiday on Scoot Henderson, Apr 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tiago Splitter on Scoot Henderson
item.description:
Tiago Splitter on Scoot Henderson:

“I don’t know if I have the words. Best game for him this season, maybe his career. He carried us.”

Tiago Splitter on Scoot Henderson, Apr 21, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Scoot Henderson
item.description:
Damian Lillard on mentoring Scoot Henderson:

“Neither one of us going to be on the court for a little bit so it will definitely create that window of opportunity for us to have a lot more dialogue... As a young PG, I know the desire. I've been there to want more for yourself... I know that I can help take some of that weight off his shoulders by just sharing information that I know is a fact.”

Damian Lillard on Scoot Henderson, Sep 30, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Scoot Henderson
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Jrue Holiday on Scoot Henderson:

“Scoot is aggressive. How he gets to the basket is amazing. Me being able to space the floor and shoot the three is something that will help him out. Being able to play off him and knowing that Scoot is the next one up and [helping him] showcase what he can do.”

Jrue Holiday on Scoot Henderson, Jul 29, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Scoot Henderson
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Chauncey Billups on Scoot Henderson going into year 2:

“You can tell that his confidence is so much different now. He plays ferocious, as we all know, but he has a little extra chip on his shoulder now after having struggled his rookie year. So I’ve been happy with where he’s at. I think Scoot’s going to have a good season.”

Chauncey Billups on Scoot Henderson, Oct 3, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Scoot Henderson
item.description:
Joe Cronin on Scoot Henderson:

“Shaky start early on, which was to be expected for a 19-year-old coming in learning how to run an offense. I like how he's navigated that.”

Joe Cronin on Scoot Henderson, Feb 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Devin Booker on Scoot Henderson
item.description:
Devin Booker on Scoot Henderson:

“Watched him when he was in the G League. I think he's going to be really good. Obviously we all have some things to learn but it looks like he loves the game, has a high IQ for it, a body built for [it] and his athleticism is off the charts.”

Devin Booker on Scoot Henderson, Oct 14, 2023. Source: Twitter @KellanOlson.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Scoot Henderson
item.description:
Chauncey Billups on Scoot Henderson:

“I didn't realize how good of a playmaker he was. I knew he was explosive and tough and competitive, but he has a feel about his game, he has a way of bringing you with him. For a young guy, that's not easy. He can get to his spots pretty easily. He can really guard. He'll learn a lot of tough lessons by the way he's so competitive. It's gonna be some tough nights that I'll have to let him go through, because that's how you learn. But he's been a dream, to teach him and watch film with him. It's been a lot of fun.”

Chauncey Billups on Scoot Henderson, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Mychal Thompson on Victor Wembanyama, Scoot Henderson
item.description:
Mychal Thompson:

“Ihope Victor Wembanyama can play at least 75 games, or really every game. If the Spurs want, they can load-manage him, take it easy on him, and play him fewer minutes in some games as his body adjusts to the NBA. I expect him to be in competition for Rookie of the Year. But there are going to be a lot of good rookies this year. It will be between him and Scoot Henderson vying for Rookie of the Year.”

Mychal Thompson on Victor Wembanyama, Scoot Henderson, Aug 31, 2023. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Damon Stoudamire on Scoot Henderson
item.description:
Kerry Eggers:Damon Stoudamire on Scoot Henderson:

“Once he learns the nuances of the NBA game, he will be fine. He is strong, athletic, a downhill guy. He is what the NBA looks like nowadays. He is that combo guard who can play with the ball and play without it.”

Damon Stoudamire on Scoot Henderson, Aug 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Anfernee Simons, Scoot Henderson, Shaedon Sharpe
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Joe Cronin:

“What I will say about Shaedon Sharpe, Scoot Henderson and Anfernee Simons is that they're going to be 'win-now' players very, very soon.”

Joe Cronin on Anfernee Simons, Scoot Henderson, Shaedon Sharpe, Jul 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Shaedon Sharpe on Scoot Henderson
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Shaedon Sharpe on playing with Scoot Henderson:

“I think we can lead us to another chip at Summer League.”

Shaedon Sharpe on Scoot Henderson, Jul 1, 2023. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Chauncey Billups, Scoot Henderson
item.description:
Kerry Eggers:More Joe Cronin on Dame and Scoot:

“It’s a possibility those two can blend well together. They can complement each other. We’ll see how Chauncey decides how to use them. I don’t know if he’ll use (Henderson) as a backup or a starter, or swing him, but basketball is about talent.”

Joe Cronin on Chauncey Billups, Scoot Henderson, Jun 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Scoot Henderson
item.description:
' @trailblazers GMJoe Cronin, on whether @Damian_Lillard and Scoot Henderson can play together:

“My goal is to keep both of them. I have zero desire to trade Dame. I really hope this works out here. You can tell how excited I am about Scoot Henderson.”

Joe Cronin on Scoot Henderson, Jun 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.
